text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Diplomatic sources say the Macedonian government's proposal for the new name of the country was "Republic of Macedonia (Skopje)". The proposal would be discussed with representatives of Greece at a meeting in New York on December 17.

- The Head of the OSCE mission in Skopje Christian Faber Rot said the mission's mandate would remain unchanged until June 30. He added the Macedonian government had every right to propose a specific regional approach of the OSCE and the creation of an OSCE centre in Skopje.
- A cameraman of the private SITEL televison station was attacked by unidentified assailants during the second round of local elections in the town of Oblavce.
- The opposition Democratic Party accused the ruling SDAM of manipulating electoral leaflets in the municipalities of Kukurecani and Mogila. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje Newsroom ++389 91 201 196
